depictions.name: Kuya Falls
depictions.text: Kuya Falls is a waterfall located in northern Arashiyama, Japan, formerly within the province of Yamashiro. In 1582, the Kakushiba ikki member and samurai Yasuke arrived at the waterfall, met with the sōhei Shorin, and learned his first kata lesson of the naginata.
